sources.title: List of HEIs entitled to start full-fledged Online Programmes from academic year 2026-27, session August, 2026
sources.notes: Title is the link text on the DEB portal (deb.ugc.ac.in/Recognition, OL > Entitled, Year 2026-27; returned by https://deb.ugc.ac.in/Recognition/SelectDetails?Year=2026-27&RecognitionType=OLE). PDF metadata title 'Entitled Online 2026-27'; 49 pages; table only. No cover letter, F.No., date, signature or conditions are printed in the PDF. The file name timestamp 20260922 suggests a 22 Sep 2026 upload, but that comes from the file name, not a printed date. Text extracted with pdftotext; key pages (30, 32, 33, 41, 42) checked visually as rendered images. The page carries a diagonal 'UNIVERSITY GRANTS COMMISSION' watermark.

sources.title: List of HEIs recognized to offer Online programmes for academic year 2026-27, session August, 2026
sources.notes: DEB portal OL > Recognised, Year 2026-27 (RecognitionType=OL). PDF metadata title 'Online Eligible 2026-27'; 8 pages; table with a 'PERIOD OF RECOGNITION' column. No printed date or cover letter. File name timestamp 20260922. This list is separate from the 'entitled' list: it covers HEIs recognized under UGC's recognition route, as opposed to HEIs entitled under regulation 3(B)(a). Contains Amity University (Uttar Pradesh) only. No Manipal and no Amity Rajasthan entry.

sources.title: List of HEIs entitled to start full-fledged Online Programmes from academic year 2025-26, session July-August, 2025
sources.notes: F.No. 1-10/2025(DEB-SR), signed Prof. Manish R. Joshi, Secretary. Cover letter with conditions: (iii) entitlement lasts only while the HEI meets the NAAC/NIRF requirements; (vi) no franchise arrangements; (viii) HEIs must write 'UGC entitled as per ... Regulations, 2020 and its amendments' instead of 'UGC recognized'. Used only for 2025-26 cross-reference notes.

programs.listedInstitution: AMITY UNIVERSITY (PRIVATE UNIVERSITY), State: UTTAR PRADESH
programs.location: Recognized list 2026-27, PDF page 7, S.No. 19, item 2)
programs.notes: Found ONLY under Amity University UTTAR PRADESH (2026-27 recognized list S.No. 19), not under Amity University Rajasthan (S.No. 78, all 9 programmes read). If amityonline.com awards this programme through Amity University Rajasthan, the listing does NOT cover it. A human needs to check which Amity entity awards it before claiming UGC entitlement or recognition. Amity Rajasthan lists only 'BACHELOR OF COMMERCE (HONS)', and Amity UP's entitled section (S.No. 108) has no B.Com. Source is the separate 2026-27 RECOGNIZED online list (not the entitled list). Period of Recognition as printed: '2022-23, academic session beginning September, 2022 (revised from July-August, 2022) and onwards to 2026–27 (upto January, 2027 only)'. Validity ends with the January 2027 session as printed. The same entry (S.No. 9) appears in the 2025-26 recognized list.
